# Identity (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`access-admin`](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md), [`backups`](../../flows/backups/FLOW.md), [`owner-setup`](../../flows/owner-setup/FLOW.md), [`password`](../../flows/password/FLOW.md), [`reviewer`](../../flows/reviewer/FLOW.md), [`security-audit`](../../flows/security-audit/FLOW.md), [`sign-in`](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md), [`two-factor-setup`](../../flows/two-factor-setup/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Who the caller is: email/password login, short-lived JWT access tokens, rotating refresh tokens in a cookie, logout and session revocation, password reset/set/change with one-time codes, two-factor by TOTP or email code (setup, login step, disable, break-glass reset), re-authentication, the one-time owner setup page, and the owner and seed CLIs (SPEC §7 D1, D7-D9, D15).

## Techniques

Use cases behind ports with Prisma adapters. Passwords hashed with argon2id; TOTP secrets sealed with AES-256-GCM (`SecretBox`, HKDF-derived key). Refresh tokens are hashed, rotated under a row lock with a short grace window. The two-factor step uses a temp token and an in-process challenge store with attempt limits. Rate limits per IP and per email (`IDENTITY_RATE_LIMIT_POLICIES`); `AllowedOriginGuard` checks the `Origin` on cookie routes. Every security action is audited through `security-audit`. CLIs run without Nest (`IdentityCli.setup.ts`).

## Technologies

NestJS 11, Passport (`passport-jwt`), Prisma 7, argon2, otplib, zod, Node.js `crypto`; mail through `infrastructure/mail`.

## Entry points

`/api/v1/auth/{login,refresh,logout,me}`, `/api/v1/auth/password/{request-otp,reset,set,change}`, `/api/v1/auth/2fa/{totp/setup,enable,disable,verify,email-challenge,email/send-code}`, `/api/v1/setup/{status,owner}`; `JwtAuthGuard`; CLIs `owner:bootstrap`, `owner:reset-2fa`, `db:seed`, seed account.

## Where to change what

High-risk path: any change gets a security review before commit. A new auth route: route constant and rate-limit policy in `http/IdentityHttp.constants.ts`, the controller, a zod request schema, the use case, an audit action, and the route snapshot test. Cookie flags are a tier 3 area.
